 tool then lifting the second and third tile carrier with container of them using crane 
 25 ton

Measure the blade and stuffing box clearances and record it in measuring form 
 No 6.

Measure the clearance of coupling between shaft turbine and intermediate 
 rotor ( at gear box side ) and record it in measuring form No 16, vertical 
 clearance and horizontal clearance and record it in measuring form No 13.
 to 
Measure the Clearance Carryout the following Steps:
 a) Tight Two jacks in the flange of gear box then the flange 
 of gear box move 16 cm in direction of gear box
 b) Connect the DC pump.
 c) Connect the jacking pump of rotor.
 d) Turn the Rotor in four position (0o , 90o ,180o 
 , 270o ).
 e) Measure the clearance in four position and take the average and record it in 
 measuring form No 16.
Dismantle and lifting the upper bearing of turbine, compressor, and thrust.

Rising the shaft of turbine using special tool (lifting rotor) with crane 80 
 ton and take it outside the unit

Measure the blade and labyrinth clearance and record it in measuring form No 
 10.
Dismantle and Lifting the lower part of compressor diffuser using crane 25 ton
Dismantle and Lifting the lower part of blade carrier using crane 25 ton
Dismantle and lifting the lower part of hot gas carrier using crane 25 ton

Dismantle all oil pipes of turbine bearing, compressor bearing and the two 
 air pipes of stuffing box.

Dismantle and lifting the lower bearing of turbine, compressor thrust and 
 pedestals of them.
Dismantle and lifting the lower part of stuffing box.
Dismantle and lifting the cover of gear box by crane 25 ton

Inspect the upper part of blade carrier by vision after reversing it, using 
 crane 25 ton for cracks, pitting, and so on .

Take the inlet Segment of blade carrier to outside and inspect it by vision 
 for cracks, pitting, wear, and so on .., if it needed to change, you must 
 change it.

Inspect the blades for cracks, pitting, wear, and so on .., and study the 
 history of blades, if they are new at the last overhaul do not change them, 
 unless if we find some of them is not good we change them. If the blades at 
 the last overhaul are recommended, we must change them.

For stationary blades, we take the blades for different stages outside the 
 blade carrier using copper bar ( 40 mm x 50 cm ) and hummer, then by the 
 same manner install the new one and install some of shims between some blades 
 according to clearance of expansion.

for moving blades, we take the blades for different stages outside the rotor 
 by taking off the welding of main lock and others locks, then take the old one 
 outside the rotor and install the new one on the rotor and weld the main 
 lock and others.

If we change the blades, we change the fiber mineral twin for second and third 
 stationary stages also change the sealing of second stationary stage and all 
 steel band for second, third, and forth stage.

If we change the blades, we inspect the stationary and moving heat shield 
 segment and change the pieces which we need to change, to change the 
 stationary heat shield segments loose the cylinder pin of these pieces and use 
 the copper bar and hammer for taking these pieces outside the blade carrier, 
 then put the new one using also copper bar and hammer to put these pieces 
 inside blade carrier and tight it by new cylinder pin.
Clean the bolts, studs, nuts and so on using remover.

Take off the balancing bolts outside plane 1 and plane 2, and taping the holes 
 of them in two planes.
Change the thermal block under the pedestal of bearing 1 by a new one .

Check the two pipes of air for stuffing box of bearing 1 and change the gasket 
 before and after the orifice of air for every pipe, then tight it in its 
 position.

Change the expansion studs of compressor diffuser and their cylinder pins by 
 new ones.

Inspect the segment complete of hot gas casing by vision, and change it if 
 needed.

Inspect the segment sup. Ring complete of hot gas casing by vision and change 
 it if needed.

Tight the two halves of turbine and compressor bearing and measure its 
 diameter in three positions from each side using the internal micrometer, if 
 the readings inside the tolerance of bearing diameter, the bearing is good.

Dismantle the two halves of turbine and compressor bearing, and inspect them 
 against cracks using detecting spray crack, if there is crack we must change 
 the bearing.

Inspect the tile ( finned segment ) carrier of combustion chamber , weld and 
 for the legs grind the holes of tiles until the width of hole from up and down 
 like to 11,6 11,7 mm.

Inspect the finned segment for combustion chamber using vernire caliper, if the 
 depth of wear in the piece is 4mm or more, this piece is rejected and change 
 it.

Inspect the gear wheels by vision and measure its clearances and record it in 
 form No 7.
Clean the gear wheels using tinier and good rags.
Use two indicators with magnetic bottom for gear A &B.
Adjust the reading of two indicators to zero reading.
Operate the jacking pump for lifting the intermediate shaft.

Move the intermediate shaft simultaneously. 
 Take the reading of two indicators and calculate the difference between the 
 two readings, this difference is the backlash between A&B.
Repeat the steps from 1 to 6 for gears C&D.
Repeat the steps from 1 to 6 for gears E&F.
Repeat the steps from 1 to 6 for gears E&G.
Record all readings in measuring form no 7.
Very easy assembly (slots and locking piece parallel to each other)
Easy assembly normal (small force to assemble like rattle by hand)
Hard assembly (Hard to assembly like with a lever, arc bar, etc)
Very hard assembly (very hard assembly like with the old of jacks etc ).

Put locking flanges at the end of path bearing No. 1& path bearing No. 
 2
Turn DC Oil pump and Jacking pump.
Turn the auxiliary lubricating oil pump 1500 rpm.
Turn the auxiliary lubricating oil pump 3000 rpm.
Turn the unit up to step 2.
Determine any leakage for oil, and make to stop it .
Turn the jack pump to float the shaft.
Push the shaft to front up to end in direction of plane l.
Put the pointer of indicator to plane 2 with adjusting the reading to zero.
Push the shaft to back up to end in direction of plane 2.
Take the reading of indicator, clearance of thrust bearing.
Record the clearance reading in form No 8.

bearing 1 according to:

items:
Measure the clearance of 
bearing 1 according to:
Take off a shim from the upper half of bearing, measure its thickness.
Put a lead wire l mm thickness on the cover of bearing shim.
Tight the cover of bearing with its pedestal.
Loose the cover from its pedestal.
Measure the thickness of lead wire.

The difference in thickness between the readings of a & e is clearance of 
 bearing 1.
Record the clearance reading in form No. 8.

Turn the unit without burning up to speed 1300 rpm and record parameters 
 related to vibration at plane 1&2

Enter the results of step a to vibration program to calculate the value of 
 weight and its angle
Install the weight at plane 2, and turn the unit up to speed 1300 rpm.

Enter the results of step c to vibration program to calculate the new value of 
 weight and its angle.
Install the weight at plane 1, and turn the unit up to speed 1300 rpm.

Enter the results of steps c&e to vibration program to calculate the final 
 weights at plane 1, plane 2, and its angles.
Punching the final weights in its positions

Tight two jacks in flange of gear box, the flange of gear box move in 
 direction of gear box
Connect the DC pump.
Connect the jacking pump of rotor.

turn the rotor in four position ( 00 , 900 , 1800
 , 2700 ) .

Measure the clearance in four positions and take the average and record it in 
 measuring form No 16.
Install and fix the upper part of cylinder using crane 80 ton.

Install and fix the combustion chamber using crane 80 ton and tight the bolts 
 between the combustion chamber and upper cylinder.
Return back the finned segment of upper cylinder to front.
Measure clearance (s) and record it in measuring form No. 1.

Measure the clearance of movable compressor Row 1, turbine Row 1 and Row 4, 
 and record it in measuring form no 2

Measure the radial over lapping (SA) and length (B), Diameter, and 
 circumference and record it in measuring form no 4

Measure the radial over lapping clearance ( S ) and length ( B ), Diameter, 
 and circumference and record it in measuring form no. 3
Install and fix the flame monitor at the ceiling of unit .

Release the plug ( face piece ) in the upper cylinder for the blow off 
 valves.
Install and fix the blow off valves using crane 25 ton.
Install and fix the piece no 3 for entry air of compressor using crane 25 ton.
Install and fix Propane gas inside unit.
Install and fix all pipes of combustion chamber.

Install and fix the two flame monitor on sides the ladder of combustion 
 chamber.
Install and fix the burner using crane 25 ton.
Install and fix gas pipe, Fuel pipe and non return valves of burner.
Install and fix the crane burner using crane 25 ton.

Release the wood pieces which close the blow off valves, and connect the 
 pipe of air which closes them during working unit.
Install and fix the blow off valves room guardian using crane 25 ton.
Install and fix the piece No2 for entry air of compressor using crane 25 ton.
Install and fix the ceiling of unit using crane 25 ton.
Install and fix the piece no.1 for entry air of compressor using crane 25 ton

Connect the electricity of all lubricated oil pump, water pump, fuel pump, 
 flame monitor blow off valves and so on
Turn the unit up to step 4 for testing leakage of and oil and fuel
Install and fix thermal block of unit.

Install and fix the pin of CO2 cylinder inside the unit for fire 
 fighting system.
Open the manual valves of fuel system ( solar and gas )
Open the valves of cooling water system.
Put fire fighting system in service.

Make the close balance for shaft of unit using vibrometer, magnetic vibration 
 sensor at plane1, magnetic vibration sensor at plane 2, and speed sensor at 
 plane 2. as follows:
Turn the unit until the burning occur and speed reaches to 4582 rpm.

Inter the results of step 1 to vibration program to calculate the value of 
 weight and its angle.
Install the weight at plane 2 and turn the unit up speed 4582 rpm.

Inter the results of step 3 to vibration program to calculate the new value 
 of weight and its angle.
Install the weight at plane 1 and turn the unit up to speed 4582 rpm.

Install the results of steps ( 3 & 5 ) to vibration program to calculate the 
 final weights at plane 1, plane 2, ad its angle
Punching the final weights in its positions.
Turn the unit with complete load for one week and observe its behavior.
